<!--
This repository tracks its work in `docs/tickets/`, not in Issues.
An accepted report becomes a `BUG` ticket, and the headings below are the ones that ticket wants filled in.
Writing them here means nobody has to rewrite the report to carry it across.
-->

## Title

<!-- One line, in the imperative, the way a ticket title reads. For example "Cannot clear with set command". -->

## Priority

<!-- 0 is most urgent and 4 is least. Data loss or a broken install is a 0 or 1. A rough edge with a workaround is a 3 or 4. -->

## Version

<!-- The output of `docket --version`, and how it was installed, `uv tool install` or `pipx` or from source. -->

## Environment

<!-- Operating system and Python version. Say whether it happens through the CLI, the MCP server, or both. -->

## What happens

<!-- The behavior you see. Paste the exact command and its full output, including any traceback. -->

## What should happen

<!-- The behavior you expected instead. -->

## Reproduction

<!--
The shortest path from an empty repository to the failure.
`docket deploy .` into a scratch directory is usually the cleanest starting point.
-->
